pages.text: Pick up Quantum Dust to reveal the qCraft branch. Obtain an Observer-Dependent Block for To Each Their Own and a Quantum Block for Going Superpositional.
pages.title: Enter qCraft

pages.text: Wear or collect Anti-Observation Goggles for A Mere Bystander. Look at a linked qBlock for Inseparable. Use an Automated Observer near you for Quantum Mechanization.
pages.title: Observe and Automate

pages.text: For No More Chickens, stay within ten blocks while an Automated Observer collapses a Quantum Block into a Redstone Block. The $(l:qcraft:automation/randomness)lamp build$(/l) gives you that outcome on some trials.
pages.title: Light the Lamp

pages.text: Obtain a Quantum Computer for What's a Qubit? Energize paired stations and complete a region swap for Efficient Transport.
pages.title: Computer Milestones

pages.text: This challenge accepts either inert qBlock item in your inventory. An unobserved placed block's appearance alone does not trigger it.
pages.title: I Like This Texture
